critical_code_review_comments: MapApp.js:230 – onChange handler correctly setTab('all') only when e.target.value.trim() is non-empty. Good: prevents unexpected tab switch on empty backspace.

MapApp.js:122 runSearch – manually rebuilds params and fetches instead of relying on the debounced fetchPoints. This works but duplicates logic. Minor: could refactor by exposing fetchPoints and calling it after setTab('all'). Not a bug.

MapApp.js:158 visiblePoints – when tab==='favorites' with a query, `points` state still contains q-filtered results and .filter(favorites) is applied on top — reasonable but the UI auto-switches to 'all' on typing, so this case is unreachable via typing (only via clicking Favoris after typing). Acceptable behaviour.

server.py _norm() – uses NFKD + strip combining chars + lower(). Matches city, postal_code (not normalized — fine since digits/ASCII), and name. Postal-code substring match ('69' matches '69001','69002',...); intentional per spec.
Panel is duplicated (desktop aside + mobile sheet) so tests MUST scope 'aside [data-testid=...]'. Documented from prior iterations; still applies.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Search bug fix is COMPLETE and verified end-to-end. Two-part fix confirmed: (1) MapApp.js search input onChange forces setTab('all') when text present, so search results are always in the visible 'all' branch; form onSubmit runSearch() also forces 'all', flies map, and toasts on empty result. (2) Backend server.py _norm() (unicodedata NFKD) makes q filter accent-insensitive across city and name. Numbers to remember: total=3193, relais=2220, lockers=973, Lyon=93, Nîmes(nimes)=21, Marseille=131, 69001=57. Panel is duplicated across desktop aside + mobile sheet → always scope selectors to 'aside'. Geolocation must be granted via context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + context.set_geolocation BEFORE page.goto for nearby-locate-btn tests.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: When user was on tab='nearby' or 'favorites', visiblePoints was computed as nearestByCarrier or favorites.filter, NOT `points` — so query-filtered points from the API were fetched (correctly) but never displayed. Symptom: search bar 'did not work'. Fix: (a) input onChange forces setTab('all') on non-empty text; (b) form submit runSearch() also forces setTab('all') plus flyTo first result and empty-toast; (c) backend _norm() adds accent-insensitive matching. All three pieces verified via UI + API.
